THE CHALLENGE

settings.title: Expanding IT Capability Without Losing the Personal Touch

settings.editor: Arcom IT needed additional technical capability while continuing to provide the responsive and personal IT experience its users expected.

The requirement went beyond simply adding another support resource. The team needed a partner that could understand its culture, how it worked, and what mattered to its people while working alongside the existing IT function.
Arcom IT needed additional technical capability to support its day-to-day IT operations and growing requirements.
Extra support is needed to keep the approachable, responsive experience users expect from the IT team.
The partner needed to integrate with Arcom IT rather than operate as a separate outsourced function.
Both teams needed to share knowledge, refine processes, and improve IT support delivery.
The Solution

settings.title: A Collaborative Managed IT Model Built Around Arcom IT

settings.editor: Folio3 worked alongside Arcom IT as an extension of its existing IT team, providing additional technical capability while maintaining a strong focus on users and collaboration.
Dedicated IT Support
Folio3 provided ongoing technical support to help Arcom IT manage day-to-day user and IT requirements.
Technical Troubleshooting
The team handled technical issues efficiently and professionally, helping resolve problems before they had a significant impact on day-to-day operations.
User-Focused Support
Folio3 focused on building relationships with end users so staff felt supported, listened to, and confident in the service they received.
Collaborative Delivery
Rather than operating independently, the Folio3 team worked closely with Arcom IT's existing IT function.
Knowledge Sharing
Both teams shared knowledge and learned from one another as processes and working practices continued to develop.
